snapshot.text: Compulsory health insurance with competing public and private insurers. Hospital audits revealed inefficiencies, and the government is reorganising emergency medical services and medicines policy.

priorities.title: New emergency medical service system
priorities.text: Šaško presented a new emergency medical service model in which ambulances return under hospitals.

priorities.title: Medicines reform
priorities.text: A pharmaceutical reform is meant to improve access to medicines.

priorities.title: OECD health cooperation
priorities.text: The minister expanded health cooperation with the OECD.
